text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yugoslav undersecretary of trade is in Baghdad to revive economic ties with Iraq.
- Trade ministry adds cooking oil and tea to foodstuffs distributed by the ministry to civil servants with prices less than those in the commercial market.
- Culture and information minister reopens a museum documenting the destruction of Iraqi establishments during the 1991 Gulf War and the reconstruction campaign launched by the government.
- Some international airliners are trying to obtain permission from the U.N. to allow them to transport food and medicine to Iraq under the oil-for-food deal.
